text: In 1912, a tailor named Franz Reichelt invented a parachute suit. He told the police he'd test it from the Eiffel Tower. With a dummy. On the day, he changed his mind. He'd test it himself. A parachute works by catching enough air to slow you down. His suit was barely bigger than a cape. From fifty-seven metres, that is nothing. He hesitated for about forty seconds. Then he jumped. He didn't survive. For once, the dummy was the smart one. And yes, the whole thing was filmed.
